helpGuideDescription: Search or open a section to learn how each part of NetDenty works, which records it changes and the rules that protect clinic data.
helpNoResultsHint: Try another word or clear the search field.
helpGuide_start_description: Sign in, choose your workspace and understand the main navigation.
helpGuide_start_1: Sign in with the username and password created by the administrator. Available menus depend on your assigned permissions.
helpGuide_start_2: If you are assigned to several clinics, select the active clinic after login. If that clinic has several assigned rooms, select the active surgical room.
helpGuide_start_3: When only one clinic and one room are assigned, NetDenty selects them automatically and does not show unnecessary selectors.
helpGuide_start_4: The clinic and room context applies to records created or viewed during the session. Check the header before entering data in another workspace.
helpGuide_start_5: Use the sidebar arrow to collapse navigation. Language, base currency and the user menu are available in the top header.
helpGuide_workspace_description: Build a dashboard from clinical, billing and inventory analytics.
helpGuide_workspace_1: Use Customize dashboard to open the right drawer and select the cards and charts relevant to your work.
helpGuide_workspace_2: Dashboard filters support monthly, yearly and custom date ranges and apply to the displayed widgets.
helpGuide_workspace_3: Clinical widgets include charges, payments, patient registrations and most-performed procedures. Billing and inventory widgets appear when you have access.
helpGuide_workspace_4: Dashboard values follow the active clinic, surgical room and current base currency.
helpGuide_appointments_description: Book and manage the clinic calendar from scheduling through the start of a visit.
helpGuide_appointments_1: Switch between day and week views, select a date and optionally filter the calendar by dentist.
helpGuide_appointments_2: Create an appointment by selecting a patient, date, start time, duration, dentist and visit reason. Notes are optional.
helpGuide_appointments_3: Search patients by name or phone. If the patient does not exist, use New Patient and complete the existing registration flow.
helpGuide_appointments_4: NetDenty warns when an active appointment overlaps another appointment or blocked period for the same dentist. Authorized users may explicitly book anyway.
helpGuide_appointments_5: Statuses are Scheduled, Confirmed, Arrived, In Treatment, Completed, Cancelled and No-show. Drag active appointments to another calendar slot to reschedule them. Cancelled appointments remain in history unless an authorized user deletes them.
helpGuide_appointments_6: Start Visit marks the appointment In Treatment and opens the patient's Sessions workspace. Completing an appointment does not complete procedures, create charges or record payments.
helpGuide_patients_description: Register, find and maintain patient records in the active workspace.
helpGuide_patients_1: Patient/File ID is generated automatically. First name, last name, Lebanese phone number and gender are required.
helpGuide_patients_2: Search live by file ID, name or phone and filter by first-visit date. Sort columns and use the table pagination controls for larger lists.
helpGuide_patients_3: Open a row to view or modify the patient. Full name is calculated from first and last name, and read-only fields are skipped during keyboard navigation.
helpGuide_patients_4: Newly saved patients return to the search list and appear first. Notes support longer clinical or administrative information.
helpGuide_patients_5: Patient records belong to the active clinic and surgical room and are only available to users with the corresponding assignment and permission.
helpGuide_treatment_description: Configure procedures and record planned or unplanned clinical work without losing history.
helpGuide_treatment_1: The Procedure Catalog stores a unique code, translated category, price, dentition, scope, chart indicator, laboratory requirement and active status.
helpGuide_treatment_2: Unplanned treatment is selected by default. Added procedures are completed immediately and contribute to the patient account and history.
helpGuide_treatment_3: Planned treatment uses treatment plans. A patient may have several plans; the latest plan opens first and New Plan creates a separate plan.
helpGuide_treatment_4: Discount is entered against the treatment total as a net amount; NetDenty retains the original total and calculates the discount amount and percentage.
helpGuide_treatment_5: Single-tooth and surface procedures require the appropriate tooth selection. Multiple-teeth and whole-mouth procedures can be added without selecting one tooth.
helpGuide_treatment_6: The 3D odontogram supports adult, pediatric and mixed dentition, independent FDI tooth identities, camera controls, arch views and a non-WebGL tooth picker.
helpGuide_treatment_7: Deleting a procedure removes its related session, laboratory, payment-account and history effects. Status changes preserve completed clinical history unless an explicit correction is made.
helpGuide_laboratory_description: Continue treatment, track external laboratory work and manage clinical files.
helpGuide_laboratory_1: Sessions list procedures with filters for tooth, procedure, status and date. Status actions are recorded with their dates.
helpGuide_laboratory_2: Laboratories are created under the Procedure Catalog and can have different rates for the same laboratory procedure.
helpGuide_laboratory_3: When a procedure requires laboratory work, selecting a laboratory is mandatory. Add material, shade and instructions in the inline treatment details.
helpGuide_laboratory_4: Laboratory requests support request, receipt and void actions. Voiding the related treatment also voids its laboratory record.
helpGuide_laboratory_5: X-rays & Files uploads images and documents through the backend. Files can be previewed, opened and deleted from the patient workspace.
helpGuide_payments_description: Understand patient balances, clinic expenses, discounts and USD/LBP conversion.
helpGuide_payments_1: The patient account shows plan estimate, charges after discount, payments received and the remaining balance. Account activity keeps original entries.
helpGuide_payments_2: Record patient payments in USD or LBP using cash or debit/credit card and include the payment date and optional notes.
helpGuide_payments_3: Currency Setup defines the clinic base currency and daily USD/LBP rate. If today's rate is missing, NetDenty uses the latest available rate in that year.
helpGuide_payments_4: Amounts are converted to the current base currency for totals while their original amount, currency and exchange-rate snapshot remain stored.
helpGuide_payments_5: Bills & Payments records clinic expenses using bill categories, payment method, currency and date. A category marked Laboratory bills requires a laboratory and its payments reduce that laboratory’s statement balance.
helpGuide_payments_6: Patient payments and clinic expenses are separate flows. Completing an appointment or procedure never creates a payment automatically.
helpGuide_inventory_description: Maintain the item catalog, purchase invoices and calculated stock.
helpGuide_inventory_1: Suppliers/Vendors stores name, optional Lebanese phone number and address for use in materials and purchase invoices.
helpGuide_inventory_2: Supplies & Materials stores item name, brand, supplier, opening balance, default purchase price and dates. Opening balance represents stock held before NetDenty use.
helpGuide_inventory_3: A purchase invoice belongs to one supplier and may contain several products assigned to that supplier.
helpGuide_inventory_4: Each invoice line requires purchase price and quantity and may include expiry date and description. Saving adds the purchased quantity to stock.
helpGuide_inventory_5: Invoices may be paid in cash or by account. Original currency values are preserved and totals are converted using the applicable exchange rate.
helpGuide_inventory_6: Deleting or amending an invoice updates its stock and expense effect so inventory analytics stay consistent.
helpGuide_analytics_description: Review clinical activity, expenses, purchases and patient or laboratory statements.
helpGuide_analytics_1: Clinical Analytics summarizes patient registrations, charges, payments, laboratory activity and most-performed procedures.
helpGuide_analytics_2: New Patients lists registrations for daily, monthly or yearly periods and supports Excel and PDF export.
helpGuide_analytics_3: Patients Statement displays detailed charges and payments for a selected patient and date range. Lab Statement reconciles laboratory charges, linked payments and remaining balances.
helpGuide_analytics_4: Billing and Inventory analytics support monthly, yearly and custom periods, comparisons, filters, charts, sortable tables and paging.
helpGuide_analytics_5: Exports use the currently applied filters. Converted totals use the clinic base currency while detail retains original currency values.
helpGuide_administration_description: Control who can use each screen and which clinic data they can access.
helpGuide_administration_1: Roles are Dentist, Assistant and Receptionist. Administrator is a separate account used for system management.
helpGuide_administration_2: Assign users to one or more clinics and surgical rooms. All scoped records are filtered by the active assigned room.
helpGuide_administration_3: Screen permissions follow the sidebar tree. View is unchecked by default; Create, Modify and Delete only work when View is enabled.
helpGuide_administration_4: Dentists also follow administrator-assigned screen permissions. Administrators retain management access.
helpGuide_administration_5: System Logs records technical API and client errors with sanitized technical details. Administrators can inspect, delete or clear log records.
helpGuide_administration_6: Deactivate an account to prevent new logins without deleting the user's historical references.
helpGuide_settings_description: Configure appearance, language and clinic-wide currency behavior.
helpGuide_settings_1: General Settings controls light or dark mode and the Clinical Teal, Dental Blue, Warm Amber, Soft Violet, Ocean Cyan and Fresh Emerald themes.
helpGuide_settings_2: Appearance preferences apply to the workstation. Shared clinic financial configuration is stored by the backend.
helpGuide_settings_3: English and French change visible labels, validation messages and supported report text.
helpGuide_settings_4: Currency Setup changes how totals are displayed and calculated; it does not rewrite the original currency stored on transactions.
helpGuide_settings_5: The header displays the active base currency as USD or LBP so users can verify the current financial context.
helpGuide_backup_description: Protect the PostgreSQL database and understand what happens during recovery.
helpGuide_backup_1: Create Backup produces a dated, sequenced PostgreSQL archive and allows choosing a local disk or USB destination.
helpGuide_backup_2: The progress indicator must finish successfully before removing a USB drive or closing NetDenty.
helpGuide_backup_3: Restore replaces the current database state with the selected archive; it does not merge duplicate or existing records.
helpGuide_backup_4: Always create a fresh backup before restoring. Other users should stop working during restore because current unsaved and newer database changes can be lost.
helpGuide_backup_5: Patient files stored outside PostgreSQL require a separate file backup unless they are included by the deployment backup process.
